card.name: Final piece of ENTYVIO and viomycin
card.fires_on: The last piece inside the brand name ENTYVIO (the "IO" after ENTYV) and the middle of the antibiotic name viomycin ("om" after vi). It appears in label text on dosing and on aminoglycoside lists.
